answer: Cross-Cluster Hardware Attestation. Each operator must submit a signed hardware root digest from three independently sourced machines; the ocean of submitted samples is cross-checked for shared physical fingerprint collisions. An identity whose digest collides with any other operator's submission triggers a lock on the operator's registration key, not the colliding wallet. Attestation must clear a verification vertex of three distinct vendor chains, and the operator posts an ivory-marked maintenance escrow released only after 90 days of clean attestations.
